title: Differential graded category
html: Differential graded category. A category enriched in cochain complexes over a commutative ring R: each hom-object \mathrm{Hom}(X, Y) is a complex of R-modules, composition is a chain map \mathrm{Hom}(Y, Z) \otimes \mathrm{Hom}(X, Y) \to \mathrm{Hom}(X, Z), and identities are cycles of degree zero. Taking zeroth cohomology of every hom-complex gives an ordinary category, the homotopy category of the dg category; a dg category with one object is a dg algebra. Dg categories are the setting in which Hochschild homology of a category, and functoriality of Hochschild homology under derived functors, are defined without choices.
